documents.text: Bartholomew Green (printer, born 1700) Bartholomew Green (January 1, 1700 – December 28, 1732) was a printer at and later the publisher of The Boston News-Letter. He was born in Cambridge, Massachusetts. The Boston News-Letter is regarded as the first continuously published newspaper in British North America. Initially, it was heavily subsidized by the British government, with a limited circulation. The News-Letter’s first editor was John Campbell.
